rows.name: ShareX
rows.reason: ShareX is a relevant Windows lead, but current configuration and alpha results need confirmation. Old conflicting discussion establishes neither a current-version pass nor a product-wide failure.

rows.name: Microsoft winapp CLI screenshot command
rows.reason: Default Windows Graphics Capture preserves rounded corners/alpha with scripted window selection, possibly including owned dialogs as panels. Screen/PrintWindow fallbacks lack that guarantee; Windows-specific and untested locally.

rows.name: Greenfoot
rows.reason: It is an educational Java programming environment, with no documented desktop window-capture or transparent-corner function.

rows.name: KDE Spectacle
rows.reason: KDE window capture with independent decorations/shadows fits Fedora KDE. Exact corner-alpha behavior across Fedora 45 Wayland and themes unproven; supplies no Windows solution.

rows.name: ZunShot
rows.reason: ZunShot preserves Windows 11 rounded-corner transparency in PNG/WebP, not arbitrary translucency. Only visible portions captured; clipboard consumers may discard alpha. Fedora support was not established.

rows.name: Greenshot
rows.reason: Window capture documented; transparency instructions cover Vista/7 Aero. Old Windows 11 reports conflict despite proposed fix; no decisive current-version exclusion. Current Windows 11 corner-alpha output remains unverified.

rows.name: CaptureGraphicsWin2D
rows.reason: Targets Windows 11 rounded-window alpha PNG capture. Windows-specific; Linux/macOS/Android and Qt 6 support unestablished. README availability by cutoff unknown; not executed.

rows.name: ZunShot
rows.reason: Windows 11 guide documents single-window capture with transparent rounded corners. Qt6/Fedora/XNU/AOSP coverage unverified; off-screen windows yield only their visible portion.

rows.name: Greenshot
rows.reason: Keep as a conditional Windows candidate: window capture and a 1.3.238 transparency fix are documented, but reported corner-alpha failures require validation.

rows.name: Flameshot 14.0 release-candidate on Wayland
rows.reason: The RC notes describe monitor/region capture through portals; neither they nor the CLI document selecting one window with transparent corners on Wayland.

rows.name: Flameshot 14.0 release-candidate on Wayland
rows.reason: Wayland RC1 prohibits automatic active-monitor selection, not necessarily specific-window capture. Window-shape alpha support or prohibition unestablished; prior failure does not identify this release. Unverified lead.

rows.name: ksnip
rows.reason: Ksnip documents Qt, CLI capability, platform coverage and window capture. Rounded-corner transparency remains unresolved; Qt6, Fedora 45 behavior and Windows 11 corner-alpha output were not verified.

rows.name: Greenfoot
rows.reason: Greenfoot is an educational Java programming environment, not a ready-made window screenshot utility. No concrete screenshot integration or transfer was supplied.

rows.name: Greenshot
rows.reason: Greenshot is a Windows lead with a version-specific attempted transparency fix. Old failures/fixes establish neither dependable current support nor current incompatibility.

rows.name: Spectacle
rows.reason: Spectacle targets KDE windows, but requested rounded-corner transparency remains unverified. The handbook does not establish alpha output; Fedora 45 and Qt6 build details were not verified.
